title: Spirit of Silverpine

[[File:Spirit of Silverpine.jpg|thumb|The ''Spirit of Silverpine'' lies broken at the bottom of the sea.]]

The '''''Spirit of Silverpine''''' is one of two sunken [[Blackwater Raiders]] [[frigate]]s located in the [[Drowned Reef]] in the coast of the [[Arathi Highlands]]. The other ship is named ''[[Maiden's Folly]]'' and lies east of the ''Spirit of Silverpine''. Both ships were part of an expedition, along with a third ship, the ''[[Harbinger]]'', in search of a lost elven treasure. When the ships were signaled by [[Shakes O'Breen]] to come dock at their location, the sea rumbled, the tides lowered, and the two ships crashed into the reef. The [[Spirit of Silverpine Charts]] and the [[Spirit of Silverpine Log]] can be found aboard the wreck.
